profile.headline: AI Software Engineer at Zoom
profile.summary:
AI engineer at Zoom. Currently building an enterprise RAG platform (SpiceDB, Temporal, connector apps for Confluence and Zendesk). Previously built and operated a 300+ GPU bare-metal training cluster and rewrote the job scheduler from scratch.

Before the AI infra work, I was on the SRE side at Zoom, where I pitched and built two tools that got adopted company-wide: an AI ticket triage system and a PII/PHI auto-redaction service.

Outside of work, I build autonomous agent systems. Recent projects include a closed-loop marketing agent with a full user simulation layer, and a compliance API reverse-engineering agent I built as contract work for a fintech startup.

positions.title: AI Software Engineer (Agentic Retrieval Infrastructure)
positions.description: Built Zoom's enterprise RAG platform. Designed the SpiceDB permission model, wrote Temporal ingestion workflows, built the Confluence and Zendesk connector apps. Customers connect their SaaS stack and agents search across all of it, sub-second, with document-level permission enforcement. Handles full org-level data syncs, incremental updates, real-time change propagation. I own my apps end-to-end.

positions.title: AI Software Engineer (AI Training & Inference Infrastructure)
positions.description: Ran a 300+ A100/H100 bare-metal cluster. Rewrote the custom Kubernetes job scheduler from scratch. No cloud GPUs, no managed anything. 95% uptime, 92% utilization. Training side: PyTorch DDP, NCCL, GPU-aware scheduling. Inference side: vLLM with continuous batching and KV caching. Full Prometheus/Grafana observability stack on top.

positions.title: Site Reliability Engineer
positions.description: Built an AI ticket triage system using vector embeddings and similarity search. Started as my side project, pitched it, shipped the MVP, then led a team to build it out. Cut manual triage work in half. Also built a PII/PHI auto-redaction service which was adopted company-wide.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Refactored backend Java services for performance and reduced complexity. Microservice architecture, Dropwizard framework, Jenkins CI.

positions.title: Networks and Systems Engineering Intern
positions.description: Built a network monitoring dashboard on AWS. Two EC2 instances, RDS database, load balancer.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: NSF-funded research. Built ML ensemble models for real-time flood prediction, serving 20,000+ collection points through an AWS data pipeline. Collaborated with a research team in Vietnam on disaster response infrastructure.
positions.insights: Skills: TensorFlow · React.js · PyTorch · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · TypeScript · Git · Python (Programming Language) · Containerization · Machine Learning · Linux · Cloud Computing

positions.title: Information Security Intern
positions.description: Monitored and triaged security incidents across the university's systems. Identified compromised machines, responded to hundreds of incidents.

positions.title: Theory of Computation Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Ran weekly discussion sections covering grammars, finite state machines, and Turing machines. Created lesson plans, hosted office hours, graded problem sets.

positions.title: Instructor
positions.description: Taught programming to 150+ students aged 10-19. Courses on game development with Java and app development with C++.

volunteerExperiences.description: Mentored high school students on a research project analyzing COVID-19's effects on global pollution levels. Built predictive models using machine learning for environmental analysis.

projects.title: Compliance API Reverse Engineering Agent — Contract (Nov 2025)
projects.description:
Takes a HAR file from a bank's compliance platform, reverse-engineers every endpoint, generates integration scripts. Onboarding went from 2 engineers / 2 weeks to 1 engineer / 2 days.

Also built a fake server that mimics the bank's API so the agent can test its own output in a loop before handing off. Contract work for an SF fintech. Built with Claude Agent SDK.

projects.title: Touchless — Autonomous Marketing Agent (2025)
projects.description:
Closed-loop marketing agent. Drops into a database it's never seen, figures out the schema, segments users, sends campaigns, waits for results, adjusts. No human in the loop.

Built a simulation layer underneath: generates fake customers with runtime-generated Python, each with their own persona and tool definitions. They receive campaigns and write actions back to the DB. The marketing agent reads those results and iterates. Agent-within-agent loop, built with Claude Agent SDK.
